projects.name: bentOS — This Portfolio
projects.shortDescription: The site you're on. A Next.js + Three.js portfolio with a 3D viewer, Matter.js BentoGrid, grounded chat assistant, and a boot-screen OS theme.
projects.description: bentOS is Kevin's personal portfolio, built as an interactive OS-themed surface rather than a static resume. Features include a boot splash gate, a procedural 3D cat in a Three.js viewer with LOD and FPS-aware perf, an infinite Matter.js-driven BentoGrid for /projects and /playground, a Gemini-backed chat assistant that only answers from grounded portfolio content, eight playable mini-games, and a long-form /scrollable view with a globe of life locations. Strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS variables for theming, Vitest + Playwright tests, Lighthouse CI, and bundle-size budgets enforced on every PR. Content (projects, photos, talking points) is file-based JSON and rebuilt automatically by an update-portfolio agent skill.

projects.name: Robotic Arm Puppeteer
projects.shortDescription: Python + ROS2 control and calibration toolkit for the OpenArm robotic platform with multi-camera AprilTag perception and 20% improved accuracy.
projects.description: Python + ROS2 control and calibration toolkit for the OpenArm robotic platform. Supports reading wrist joint positions, calibrating motion ranges, and integrates seamlessly with ROS2 for robotic simulation and control. Features multi-camera AprilTag perception with covariance-based accuracy filtering.

projects.name: Expressive AI Robot Head
projects.shortDescription: ROS2-based robotic head with LLM integration, speech recognition, and 12-servo organic mesh design for human-like interactions.
projects.description: ROS2-based robotic head integrating LLMs, speech recognition, vision, and servo control for human-like interactions. Features GPU-accelerated CUDA pipeline, 12-servo organic mesh design, and real-time speech workflow using Whisper and llama.cpp.

projects.name: AR Gesture Controlled Robot

projects.description: Modular robot platform controlled through Snap Spectacles AR glasses. End-to-end gesture-to-motion pipeline using Snap API, Flask, HiveMQ MQTT, and ROS2. Sub-100ms latency with NVIDIA Jetson Nano for on-device AI inference.
